[Problem]{.card-kicker} **Find All Numbers Disappeared in an Array** [LC 448 · Find All Numbers Disappeared in an Array](https://leetcode.com/problems/find-all-numbers-disappeared-in-an-array/){difficulty="Easy"}

A hash set of $1..n$ minus the values works, but the follow-up forbids it. The promise $\mathit{nums}[i] \in [1, n]$ is the giveaway: the array has exactly one slot per possible value, so it *can be its own set*. Walk each value, and use it (via $x-1$) as an index to "flag" that value as seen — flip the sign of the cell it points at. The un-flagged cells are the missing numbers.

[Solved in full in @sec-lts-p2-a.]{.card-link}

:::
